senses.en: the muscle below your lungs that helps you breathe
a thin flexible sheet that vibrates in sound equipment
a camera part that controls how much light enters

ex.en: The singing teacher explained how the diaphragm supports breathing.
ex.zh: 声乐老师讲解了横膈膜如何帮助呼吸。

ex.en: During inhalation, the diaphragm contracts and moves downward, allowing the lungs to expand as air enters.
ex.zh: 吸气时，横膈膜收缩并向下移动，使肺部随着空气进入而扩张。

tip: 解剖学义也称膈肌；注意ph发/f/，g不发音。

senses.en: able to understand and work with numbers

ex.en: The shop needs numerate staff who can calculate change.
ex.zh: 这家店需要会计算找零、具备基本计算能力的员工。

ex.en: Schools should ensure that all students become numerate enough to manage personal finances and interpret basic statistics.
ex.zh: 学校应确保所有学生都具备足够的计算能力，能够管理个人财务并理解基础统计数据。

col: numerate staff｜具备计算能力的员工
literate and numerate｜具备读写和计算能力的
tip: 现代常作形容词，指有计算能力；名词为numeracy。

senses.en: a cell that carries messages in the nervous system

ex.en: The brain has billions of neurons.
ex.zh: 大脑有数十亿个神经元。

ex.en: When we learn a new skill, connections between neurons become stronger through repeated use.
ex.zh: 学习新技能时，神经元之间的连接会因反复使用而增强。

tip: neural 神经的。

senses.zh: 协同一致的；共同筹划的
senses.en: Planned and carried out together to achieve a shared goal.
Involving determined effort directed towards a particular goal.

ex.en: Our concerted efforts finally cleared the garden of rubbish.
ex.zh: 我们齐心协力，终于清除了花园里的垃圾。

ex.en: Reducing urban air pollution requires concerted action from local authorities, transport providers, businesses and residents.
ex.zh: 减少城市空气污染需要地方政府、交通服务商、企业和居民采取协同行动。

col: concerted effort｜共同努力；全力投入
tip: 常修饰effort或action，强调协同或集中全力。

senses.en: The ability to understand and share the feelings of others.

ex.en: Reading fiction may increase empathy.
ex.zh: 阅读小说可能增强同理心。

senses.en: A broad, mostly treeless grassland in North America

ex.en: We watched tall grass ripple across the open prairie.
ex.zh: 我们看着高高的草在开阔的大草原上起伏。

ex.en: Protecting native prairie habitats helps preserve biodiversity and maintains grassland ecosystems that store substantial amounts of carbon.
ex.zh: 保护原生北美草原生境有助于维护生物多样性，并维持储存大量碳的草原生态系统。

tip: 通常特指北美草原；泛指草地可用 grassland。

senses.en: Very strong, powerful, or large.
Very; used informally to make a description stronger.

ex.en: A mighty oak stood in the middle of the field.
ex.zh: 田野中央矗立着一棵高大的橡树。

ex.en: Although mighty rivers provide valuable renewable energy, building large dams can seriously disrupt surrounding ecosystems.
ex.zh: 尽管大河能提供宝贵的可再生能源，修建大型水坝仍可能严重扰乱周边生态系统。

tip: 形容词常带文学色彩；副词义“很”较口语化。

senses.en: An addictive substance from poppies, used to produce certain painkillers

ex.en: The museum guide explained how opium affected trade.
ex.zh: 博物馆讲解员介绍了鸦片如何影响贸易。

ex.en: Historical research shows that the opium trade had lasting economic and social consequences for several countries.
ex.zh: 历史研究表明，鸦片贸易给多个国家带来了长期的经济和社会影响。

tip: 不可数名词，专指鸦片，不泛指所有麻醉剂。

senses.en: a hunting bird with pointed wings and a curved beak

ex.en: A falcon circled above the cliffs this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一只隼在悬崖上方盘旋。

ex.en: Protecting cliff habitats can help falcon populations recover in regions where suitable nesting sites have disappeared.
ex.zh: 在适宜巢址已经消失的地区，保护悬崖栖息地有助于隼的种群恢复。

tip: falcon指隼，不宜与泛指鹰的hawk完全等同。

senses.en: Refuse to buy or participate in something as a protest.
An organized refusal to buy or participate as a protest.

ex.en: Local shoppers decided to boycott the store over unfair wages.
ex.zh: 当地购物者因工资待遇不公而决定抵制这家商店。

ex.en: A consumer boycott can pressure companies to improve working conditions throughout their international supply chains.
ex.zh: 消费者抵制行动能向企业施压，促使其改善整个国际供应链中的工作条件。

col: call for a boycott｜呼吁抵制
boycott an event｜拒绝参加活动
tip: 动词后直接接抵制对象；名词常用a boycott of。

senses.en: the role a species plays in its environment
a suitable position or a specialized market

ex.en: She found her niche in teaching.
ex.zh: 她在教学中找到了自己的位置。

ex.en: Two species rarely share exactly the same niche, because one would eventually outcompete the other.
ex.zh: 两个物种很少占据完全相同的生态位，因为其中一方终将胜出。

tip: 生态学核心概念。

senses.en: fair to everyone involved, taking their different circumstances into account

ex.en: We agreed on an equitable division of household chores.
ex.zh: 我们商定了公平合理的家务分工。

ex.en: An equitable funding system would direct more resources towards schools serving disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 公平合理的拨款制度会将更多资源投向服务弱势社区的学校。

tip: equitable强调按情况公平，不一定是equal的均等。

senses.en: describing a woman who is short and has a small build
describing clothes designed to fit shorter women

ex.en: My sister is petite and often needs shorter trousers.
ex.zh: 我姐姐身材娇小，经常需要裤腿较短的裤子。

ex.en: Clothing retailers can serve a wider range of customers by offering petite sizes alongside their standard collections.
ex.zh: 服装零售商可以在标准系列之外提供小个子尺码，以满足更多顾客的需求。

tip: 通常形容成年女性娇小，不等于单纯“瘦”。

senses.en: widely recognised as representing a place, style, or idea

ex.en: We stopped to photograph the city's iconic stone bridge.
ex.zh: 我们停下来拍摄这座城市标志性的石桥。

ex.en: Preserving iconic buildings can strengthen cultural identity, although maintenance costs may place pressure on public budgets.
ex.zh: 保护标志性建筑可以增强文化认同，但维护费用可能给公共预算带来压力。

tip: 不只是“著名”，还强调鲜明的代表性和辨识度。

senses.en: Angry or violent behavior toward others.

ex.en: Frustration can lead to aggression.
ex.zh: 挫折可能导致攻击性行为。

senses.en: A person or thing that triggers or accelerates change.
A substance that speeds up a reaction without being consumed.

ex.en: That conversation became the catalyst for our neighbourhood cleanup.
ex.zh: 那次谈话促成了我们社区的清洁行动。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can act as a catalyst for wider economic growth in disadvantaged regions.
ex.zh: 公共交通投资可以推动欠发达地区更广泛的经济增长。

col: a catalyst for change｜变革的推动因素
act as a catalyst｜起推动作用
tip: 比喻推动变化时常用a catalyst for。

senses.en: The edible inner part of a nut, or a grain seed.
The central or most important part of something.
The central software component that manages a computer's basic operations.

ex.en: She cracked the walnut and carefully removed the kernel.
ex.zh: 她敲开核桃，小心地取出果仁。

ex.en: Even exaggerated media reports may contain a kernel of truth that deserves further investigation by independent researchers.
ex.zh: 即使是夸大的媒体报道，也可能包含值得独立研究者进一步调查的些许事实。

col: a kernel of truth｜些许事实
operating system kernel｜操作系统内核
tip: kernel指壳内的仁或谷粒，不是桃子等的硬核。

senses.en: A short account of the main points of a work.

ex.en: I read the synopsis before borrowing the novel.
ex.zh: 借这本小说之前，我先看了故事梗概。

ex.en: Students should provide a brief synopsis of their proposed research before discussing the methods they intend to use.
ex.zh: 学生在讨论拟采用的方法之前，应先简要概述计划开展的研究。

col: a synopsis of the report｜报告概要
tip: 复数为synopses；常用a synopsis of表示某作品的梗概。

senses.en: The forceful prevention of an activity or expression.
The deliberate prevention of information from becoming known.
The reduction or control of a reaction or process.

ex.en: His suppression of laughter failed when the puppy sneezed.
ex.zh: 小狗一打喷嚏，他就再也忍不住笑了。

ex.en: The suppression of public debate can weaken trust in institutions and prevent communities from addressing serious problems.
ex.zh: 压制公共讨论会削弱人们对机构的信任，并妨碍社区解决严重问题。

tip: 通常不可数；动词为suppress，注意双写pp和ss。

senses.en: moving from place to place rather than living in one place

ex.en: They lived a nomadic life.
ex.zh: 他们过着游牧生活。

ex.en: Nomadic herders moved their animals between summer and winter pastures to find fresh grass.
ex.zh: 游牧民在夏季牧场和冬季牧场之间迁移牲畜，寻找新鲜草料。

tip: 反义 sedentary（定居的）。

senses.en: a return to activity, strength, or popularity
a new production of a play or other older performance

ex.en: Our local market is enjoying a revival this spring.
ex.zh: 今年春天，我们当地的市场又热闹起来了。

ex.en: A revival of traditional crafts can create employment while preserving skills that might otherwise disappear.
ex.zh: 传统手工艺的复兴既能创造就业，也能保留原本可能失传的技艺。

col: a revival of interest｜兴趣的重新燃起
tip: revival强调衰退或沉寂后重新活跃。

senses.en: To exist in large quantities or be very common

ex.en: Wildflowers abound in the fields behind our house each spring.
ex.zh: 每年春天，我们屋后的田野里都开满野花。

ex.en: Opportunities for renewable energy development abound in regions with consistent sunshine and strong coastal winds.
ex.zh: 在日照稳定且沿海风力强劲的地区，可再生能源的发展机会十分丰富。

col: abound in wildlife｜野生动物丰富
tip: 不及物动词；某地充满某物用abound in/with。

senses.en: to think carefully about something for some time

ex.en: She pondered the menu before ordering vegetable soup.
ex.zh: 她仔细看了看菜单，才点了蔬菜汤。

ex.en: Policymakers must ponder the long-term consequences of replacing public transport services with privately operated alternatives.
ex.zh: 政策制定者必须仔细考虑用私营服务取代公共交通服务的长期后果。

col: ponder a question｜认真思考问题
ponder the implications｜仔细考虑可能的影响
ponder over something｜反复思量某事
tip: 可直接接宾语，也可用ponder on/over。

senses.en: to determine someone's future or something's intended purpose

ex.en: Everyone thought the talented young dancer was destined for success.
ex.zh: 大家都觉得这位有天赋的年轻舞者注定会成功。

ex.en: Children from disadvantaged backgrounds are not destined to fail if they receive appropriate educational support and opportunities.
ex.zh: 如果获得适当的教育支持和机会，弱势背景的儿童并非注定会失败。

col: be destined to do｜注定会做
be destined for success｜注定成功
goods destined for export｜预定出口的货物
tip: 几乎总用被动：be destined for或to do。

senses.en: Unfriendly or angry feelings or behavior.

ex.en: Competition between groups increased hostility.
ex.zh: 群体间的竞争加剧了敌意。

senses.en: to be greater or better than someone or something

ex.en: Your homemade cakes surpass anything sold at our local bakery.
ex.zh: 你自制的蛋糕比我们附近面包店卖的任何蛋糕都好。

ex.en: Demand for renewable energy may surpass current forecasts as governments introduce stronger measures to reduce carbon emissions.
ex.zh: 随着各国政府采取更有力的减碳措施，可再生能源需求可能超过目前的预测。

col: surpass previous levels｜超过以往水平
tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语，不加than。

senses.en: To increase gradually in amount, strength, or seriousness.
To attach something firmly to a surface or support.
To organize and begin an activity, campaign, or event.

ex.en: Dirty dishes mounted up while our dishwasher was broken.
ex.zh: 洗碗机坏了，脏碗碟越积越多。

ex.en: As pressure mounts to reduce emissions, governments must expand renewable energy production and improve energy efficiency.
ex.zh: 随着减排压力不断增加，各国政府必须扩大可再生能源生产并提高能源效率。

col: mount on a wall｜安装在墙上
tip: mount可指压力等上升；mount a campaign指发起运动。

senses.en: to care for and help grow
the care given to someone as they grow

ex.en: Parents nurture their children's talents.
ex.zh: 父母培养孩子的才能。

ex.en: The debate over nature versus nurture asks whether traits come mainly from genes or from experience.
ex.zh: 先天与后天之争探讨的是特质主要来自基因还是经历。

tip: nature vs nurture 是心理学经典话题。

senses.en: To use something effectively for a particular purpose.

ex.en: We utilize the space under our stairs for storage.
ex.zh: 我们利用楼梯下的空间储物。

ex.en: Schools can utilize existing buildings more efficiently by sharing facilities with local communities after lessons.
ex.zh: 学校可以在课后与当地社区共享设施，从而更高效地利用现有建筑。

col: utilize available space｜利用现有空间
tip: 比use正式；英式也常拼作utilise。

senses.en: An electronic component that amplifies signals or switches electrical current.

ex.en: She carefully replaced the damaged transistor inside the old radio.
ex.zh: 她小心地更换了旧收音机里损坏的晶体管。

ex.en: The development of smaller transistors has enabled computers to process information faster while consuming less power.
ex.zh: 更小型晶体管的研发让计算机能够更快地处理信息，同时减少耗电。

tip: 指电子元件；transistor radio才是晶体管收音机。

senses.en: Extremely beautiful and carefully made.
Describing a feeling or sensitivity of unusual intensity.

ex.en: She keeps an exquisite porcelain bowl on the shelf.
ex.zh: 她把一只精美的瓷碗放在架子上。

ex.en: Museums preserve exquisite examples of traditional craftsmanship, allowing future generations to appreciate their cultural and artistic value.
ex.zh: 博物馆保存传统工艺的精美作品，让后代能够欣赏其文化与艺术价值。

tip: 常形容精美工艺；修饰pain时表示极其强烈。

senses.en: a raised bank supporting transport routes or holding back water

ex.en: We walked along the embankment beside the swollen river.
ex.zh: 我们沿着涨水的河流旁的堤岸散步。

ex.en: Strengthening the river embankment could protect nearby homes from flooding as extreme rainfall becomes more frequent.
ex.zh: 随着极端降雨日益频繁，加固河堤可以保护附近住宅免受洪水侵袭。

tip: 既可指挡水的堤岸，也可指承托公路或铁路的路堤。

senses.en: unable to work or exist together successfully
too different in character to have a good relationship

ex.en: These headphones are incompatible with my old phone.
ex.zh: 这副耳机与我的旧手机不兼容。

ex.en: Rapid industrial expansion is often incompatible with efforts to protect fragile ecosystems without effective regulation.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏有效监管，工业快速扩张往往与保护脆弱生态系统的努力相冲突。

tip: 固定搭配为incompatible with，不用incompatible to。

senses.en: Processed to remove unwanted substances.
Showing polite manners, good taste, and cultural awareness.
Improved through careful changes to details.

ex.en: This recipe uses honey instead of refined white sugar.
ex.zh: 这道食谱用蜂蜜代替精制白糖。

ex.en: Public health campaigns often encourage people to reduce their consumption of foods containing large amounts of refined sugar.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传常鼓励人们少吃含有大量精制糖的食品。

tip: 形容物质指提纯，形容人或举止指文雅。

senses.en: A strong emotional bond with someone.

ex.en: Infants form an attachment to their main caregiver.
ex.zh: 婴儿会对主要照顾者形成依恋。

senses.en: The upper chamber of parliament in some countries
The governing council of ancient Rome

ex.en: Our class watched the senate debate on television today.
ex.zh: 今天我们班在电视上观看了参议院的辩论。

ex.en: In some political systems, the senate reviews proposed laws and represents regional interests within the national government.
ex.zh: 在某些政治制度中，参议院审查法律提案，并在国家政府中代表地区利益。

col: a seat in the senate｜参议院席位
tip: 指特定国家的参议院时，通常写作the Senate。

senses.en: a building for watching stars or natural events

ex.en: We visited an observatory on the mountain.
ex.zh: 我们参观了山上的天文台。

ex.en: Observatories are built on high mountains where the air is thin and dry, giving clearer views of the sky.
ex.zh: 天文台建在高山上，那里空气稀薄干燥，观测天空更清晰。

tip: 重音在第二音节。

senses.en: Logical and clear, with parts that fit together well.

ex.en: After some practice, he gave a clear, coherent explanation.
ex.zh: 经过一些练习，他给出了清晰而有条理的解释。

ex.en: A coherent transport policy should connect investment in public services with long-term environmental and economic goals.
ex.zh: 一项协调一致的交通政策应将公共服务投资与长期环境和经济目标联系起来。

col: a coherent argument｜条理清楚的论证
a coherent explanation｜连贯清晰的解释
a coherent strategy｜协调一致的策略
tip: 强调内容逻辑连贯；cohesive更强调各部分衔接紧密。

senses.en: Correct something that is wrong or unsatisfactory.

ex.en: The shop quickly rectified the mistake and refunded me.
ex.zh: 商店很快纠正了错误，并给我退款。

ex.en: Local authorities must rectify weaknesses in drainage systems before increasingly heavy rainfall causes further damage.
ex.zh: 地方政府必须在日益强烈的降雨造成更多损害之前，纠正排水系统中的缺陷。

tip: 正式用词，常接error、mistake、situation。

senses.en: Already referred to earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: Please bring the above-mentioned documents to our next meeting.
ex.zh: 请把上述文件带到我们的下次会议上。

ex.en: The above-mentioned measures could reduce urban air pollution if local authorities provide sufficient funding and oversight.
ex.zh: 如果地方政府提供足够的资金和监管，上述措施就可能减少城市空气污染。

tip: 正式书面语，常置于名词前；写作中勿滥用。

senses.en: strange or unusual, in an old-fashioned use
describing sexual or gender identities outside heterosexual or conventional categories

ex.en: There was a queer rattling sound inside the cupboard.
ex.zh: 橱柜里传来一阵奇怪的咔嗒声。

ex.en: Museums increasingly include queer perspectives to reflect a broader range of experiences in their exhibitions.
ex.zh: 博物馆越来越多地纳入酷儿视角，以在展览中呈现更广泛的人生经历。

tip: “奇怪的”义较旧；身份义宜尊重当事人自称。
note: 用于性或性别身份时，有人自称酷儿，也有人认为此词冒犯。

senses.en: Relating to ships, sailing, or navigation at sea

ex.en: My uncle collects old nautical maps and wooden boats.
ex.zh: 我叔叔收藏旧海图和木制小船。

ex.en: Modern nautical equipment helps crews navigate safely, but practical training remains essential for preventing accidents at sea.
ex.zh: 现代航海设备帮助船员安全航行，但实践培训对于预防海上事故仍然至关重要。

tip: nautical侧重航海和船舶；naval专指海军的。

senses.en: to make previously private or unknown information available

ex.en: The hotel would not disclose any details about its guests.
ex.zh: 这家酒店不愿透露住客的任何信息。

ex.en: Companies should disclose how they collect personal data so that consumers can make informed decisions.
ex.zh: 企业应公开其收集个人数据的方式，让消费者能够作出知情决定。

col: disclose something to someone｜向某人透露某事
tip: 用disclose sth to sb；也可接that从句。

senses.en: no longer used because something better exists

ex.en: Fax machines are nearly obsolete.
ex.zh: 传真机几乎被淘汰了。

ex.en: The railway made many canals obsolete, as trains could carry goods faster and in any season.
ex.zh: 铁路使许多运河被淘汰，因为火车运货更快且不受季节限制。

tip: 托福同义替换：obsolete ≈ outdated。

senses.en: strong annoyance caused by repeated problems or irritating behaviour

ex.en: She sighed in exasperation when the printer jammed again.
ex.zh: 打印机又卡纸了，她恼火地叹了口气。

ex.en: Repeated delays in public transport can cause widespread exasperation and reduce confidence in local authorities.
ex.zh: 公共交通反复延误会引发普遍的不满，并削弱公众对地方政府的信任。

col: a sigh of exasperation｜恼火的叹息
tip: 表示烦到失去耐心；勿与加剧混淆。

senses.en: Not using words.

ex.en: Smiles and gestures are forms of nonverbal communication.
ex.zh: 微笑和手势是非语言交流的形式。

senses.en: Disagreement or conflict between people or groups.
A combination of musical sounds that clash unpleasantly.

ex.en: Arguments about chores caused discord among the flatmates.
ex.zh: 关于家务的争吵导致室友之间不和。

ex.en: Unequal access to resources can fuel social discord, particularly when communities feel excluded from political decisions.
ex.zh: 资源获取不平等会加剧社会纷争，尤其是在群体感到被排除在政治决策之外时。

col: a source of discord｜纷争的根源
tip: 表示不和时通常不可数，语气比disagreement正式。

senses.en: welcoming people of different backgrounds and abilities
including all relevant costs
including both the first and last points of a range

ex.en: Our inclusive dance class welcomes people of all abilities.
ex.zh: 我们的舞蹈课注重包容，欢迎各种能力水平的人参加。

ex.en: Schools should create inclusive learning environments where students with different needs can participate fully in classroom activities.
ex.zh: 学校应营造包容的学习环境，让需求不同的学生都能充分参与课堂活动。

tip: inclusive of表示“包含”；日期范围后用它表示首尾均含。

senses.en: Something that occurs, especially an unusual or interesting event.

ex.en: My uncle entertains us with stories of strange happenings.
ex.zh: 叔叔给我们讲各种怪事，逗我们开心。

ex.en: Local newspapers record everyday happenings that help future researchers understand how communities lived and changed.
ex.zh: 地方报纸记录日常事件，帮助后来的研究者了解社区居民的生活及其变化。

tip: 作名词常用复数happenings；正式事件通常用event。

senses.en: To flow out suddenly in large amounts.
To express enthusiasm or praise in an excessive way.
A sudden, strong flow of liquid.

ex.en: Water gushed from the broken pipe beneath the sink.
ex.zh: 水从水槽下方破裂的管道里喷涌而出。

ex.en: When ageing pipes burst, clean water can gush into streets, wasting resources and disrupting local transport.
ex.zh: 老化的管道爆裂时，清水会涌上街道，浪费资源并扰乱当地交通。

col: gush from a pipe｜从管道中喷出
gush about something｜对某事赞不绝口
a gush of water｜一股涌出的水
tip: 谈论人时，gush about常暗示赞美过于热情。

senses.en: Relating to a system exchanging land for service and loyalty.

ex.en: The guide explained how feudal lords controlled this valley.
ex.zh: 导游讲解了封建领主如何控制这片山谷。

ex.en: Under the feudal system, access to land largely determined a person's social position and economic security.
ex.zh: 在封建制度下，土地的获取在很大程度上决定了个人的社会地位和经济保障。

tip: 主要描述土地换取效忠与服役的历史制度。

senses.en: Ordinary written language, rather than poetry

ex.en: Her clear prose makes this book easy to enjoy.
ex.zh: 她清晰流畅的文笔让这本书读起来轻松愉快。

ex.en: Reading well-crafted prose can help students develop a wider vocabulary and express complex ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 阅读精心写就的散文可以帮助学生扩大词汇量，更清晰地表达复杂观点。

tip: 不可数；不限于文学散文，也包括小说等非韵文。

senses.en: not letting light through
hard to understand

ex.en: The bathroom window is opaque.
ex.zh: 浴室窗户是不透明的。

ex.en: Clouds of volcanic ash can make the atmosphere almost opaque, blocking sunlight for months.
ex.zh: 火山灰云会使大气几乎不透光，遮挡阳光长达数月。

tip: 三级：transparent > translucent > opaque。

senses.en: to make a process simpler and more efficient
to shape something to move easily through air or water

ex.en: We streamlined our morning routine to leave home earlier.
ex.zh: 我们简化了早晨的日常安排，以便早点出门。

ex.en: Hospitals can streamline appointment systems to reduce waiting times and improve access to essential care.
ex.zh: 医院可以优化预约系统，缩短等待时间，让人们更容易获得必要的医疗服务。

tip: 通常作动词；“流线型的”用 streamlined。

senses.en: One part or aspect of a complex subject.
A small flat surface on a cut stone.

ex.en: Cooking together revealed a new facet of her personality.
ex.zh: 一起做饭展现了她性格中新的一面。

ex.en: Public transport affects almost every facet of urban life, from employment opportunities to air quality.
ex.zh: 公共交通几乎影响城市生活的每个方面，从就业机会到空气质量。

col: a facet of life｜生活的一个方面
tip: 常用 a facet of，指复杂事物的一个方面。

senses.en: Relating to nerves or the nervous system.

ex.en: Learning creates new neural connections.
ex.zh: 学习会建立新的神经连接。

senses.en: to walk for pleasure without following a fixed route
to talk at length without a clear focus
a long walk for pleasure, especially in the countryside

ex.en: We rambled through the woods until it started raining.
ex.zh: 我们在树林里漫步，直到下起雨来。

ex.en: Speakers who ramble during presentations may struggle to communicate their main arguments clearly to an audience.
ex.zh: 演讲时漫无边际的人可能难以向听众清晰传达自己的主要论点。

col: ramble through the countryside｜在乡间漫步
ramble on about something｜絮絮叨叨地说某事
tip: ramble on 常指说话冗长散漫，带不耐烦语气。

senses.en: Speed of movement, including direction in physics.

ex.en: The ball gained velocity as it rolled downhill.
ex.zh: 球向坡下滚动时速度越来越快。

ex.en: Engineers measure the velocity of flowing water to determine whether a site is suitable for generating electricity.
ex.zh: 工程师测量水流速度，以判断某处是否适合发电。

tip: 物理中velocity含方向，speed只表示快慢。

senses.en: Belonging naturally to something, rather than coming from outside

ex.en: She values the intrinsic beauty of untreated wood.
ex.zh: 她欣赏未经加工的木材本身的美。

ex.en: Schools should encourage intrinsic motivation by helping students enjoy learning rather than focusing solely on external rewards.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生享受学习，培养内在动力，而不是只关注外部奖励。

tip: intrinsic to表示“……所固有的”。

senses.en: to stop a fire or flame from burning
to bring a feeling, hope, or idea to an end

ex.en: We extinguished the campfire before getting into our tents.
ex.zh: 我们在进入帐篷前扑灭了篝火。

ex.en: Prolonged unemployment can extinguish young people's hopes of achieving financial independence and securing stable housing.
ex.zh: 长期失业可能使年轻人实现经济独立和获得稳定住房的希望破灭。

tip: 及物动词；日常说扑灭也可用put out。

senses.en: relating to the eye or vision

ex.en: The optic nerve connects the eye to the brain.
ex.zh: 视神经连接眼睛和大脑。

ex.en: Fiber optic cables carry information as pulses of light through thin glass threads.
ex.zh: 光纤电缆以光脉冲的形式通过细玻璃丝传输信息。

tip: optics 光学。

senses.en: Gradually become smaller in amount, size, or number.

ex.en: Our savings dwindled while we searched for new jobs.
ex.zh: 我们找新工作期间，积蓄逐渐减少了。

ex.en: As freshwater supplies dwindle, governments must invest in efficient irrigation and encourage households to reduce unnecessary consumption.
ex.zh: 随着淡水供应逐渐减少，政府必须投资高效灌溉，并鼓励家庭减少不必要的用水。

tip: 不及物动词，强调逐渐减少，不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: a part that moves inside a cylinder in engines or pumps

ex.en: The mechanic removed a damaged piston from the engine.
ex.zh: 机修工从发动机中拆下了一个损坏的活塞。

ex.en: In a conventional engine, expanding gases push each piston, converting energy from fuel into mechanical motion.
ex.zh: 在传统发动机中，膨胀的气体推动每个活塞，将燃料的能量转化为机械运动。

tip: 活塞在 cylinder（气缸）内往复运动。

senses.en: Always, or on every occasion.

ex.en: My brother invariably falls asleep during long train journeys.
ex.zh: 我哥哥每次坐长途火车都会睡着。

ex.en: In this study, participants with longer commuting times invariably reported having less time for leisure activities.
ex.zh: 在这项研究中，通勤时间较长的参与者无一例外都表示，自己的休闲时间较少。

tip: 比usually语气更强，表示每次如此，而非通常如此。

senses.en: to control an entire market or supply of something
to use something so much that others cannot share it

ex.en: Please don't monopolize the conversation throughout dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚吃饭时请别一直只顾自己说话。

ex.en: When a few large firms monopolize essential services, consumers may face higher prices and fewer choices.
ex.zh: 当少数大公司垄断基本服务时，消费者可能面临更高的价格和更少的选择。

col: monopolize someone's attention｜独占某人的注意力
tip: 英式也常拼作monopolise；可指市场或注意力。

senses.en: A hormone released when you are frightened or excited.

ex.en: A rush of adrenaline made her heart pound.
ex.zh: 一阵肾上腺素让她心跳加速。

senses.en: unable to live forever
causing or likely to cause death
a human being who cannot live forever

ex.en: Even the strongest heroes in this story are mortal.
ex.zh: 这个故事里，即使最强大的英雄也终有一死。

ex.en: Recognising that we are mortal can encourage healthier habits and a greater appreciation of everyday life.
ex.zh: 认识到生命终有尽头，可以促使我们养成更健康的习惯，更加珍惜日常生活。

tip: mortal指凡人；死亡率用mortality，不用mortal。

senses.en: The act or written notice of leaving a job voluntarily.
Calm acceptance of something unpleasant that seems impossible to change.

ex.en: She handed in her resignation after finding another job.
ex.zh: 她找到另一份工作后提交了辞职信。

ex.en: The resignation of experienced nurses can place additional pressure on hospitals already struggling with staff shortages.
ex.zh: 经验丰富的护士辞职，会给本已面临人员短缺的医院带来额外压力。

col: hand in your resignation｜提交辞职信
tip: 辞职用resignation；另一义是无奈接受，不是反抗。

senses.en: Careful not to upset or offend people.

ex.en: Her tactful reply saved everyone from an awkward argument.
ex.zh: 她得体的回答让大家避免了一场尴尬的争论。

ex.en: Managers who provide tactful feedback can address performance problems while maintaining employees' confidence and motivation.
ex.zh: 管理者以得体的方式提供反馈，既能解决工作表现问题，也能维持员工的信心和积极性。

tip: 强调顾及他人感受、言行得体，不是反应机敏。

senses.en: to find your position or adjust to a situation
to direct toward a purpose

ex.en: It took me a day to orient myself in the new city.
ex.zh: 我花了一天才熟悉新城市。

ex.en: Sea turtles orient themselves using the earth's magnetic field when returning to the beach where they hatched.
ex.zh: 海龟利用地球磁场辨别方向，回到它们孵化的海滩。

tip: 英式也作 orientate。

senses.en: a unit used to measure electric current

ex.en: This small lamp draws less than one ampere.
ex.zh: 这盏小灯的电流不到一安培。

ex.en: Students measured the current in amperes to compare the electrical requirements of different household appliances.
ex.zh: 学生们以安培为单位测量电流，以比较不同家用电器的用电需求。

col: electric current in amperes｜以安培计的电流
one ampere of current｜一安培电流
tip: 符号为A；口语常缩为amp，复数加s。

senses.en: To change a document, rule, or plan to improve it.

ex.en: Please amend the booking to include one extra guest.
ex.zh: 请修改预订，增加一位客人。

ex.en: Parliament may amend existing legislation to ensure that remote workers receive the same protections as office employees.
ex.zh: 议会可能修订现行法律，确保远程工作者获得与办公室员工相同的保护。

tip: 常指修改文件或法律；修理实物通常用mend。

senses.en: a poor farmer working a small plot of land

ex.en: The painting shows a peasant carrying vegetables home.
ex.zh: 这幅画描绘了一位背着蔬菜回家的农民。

ex.en: Historically, peasant families often depended on a single harvest, making them particularly vulnerable to drought.
ex.zh: 历史上，小农家庭往往依赖一次收成，因此特别容易受到干旱的影响。

tip: 多用于历史或传统农业语境；称呼他人可能带贬义。

senses.en: Required by a law or rule.

ex.en: Wearing a helmet is mandatory at this climbing centre.
ex.zh: 在这家攀岩中心，必须佩戴头盔。

ex.en: Mandatory safety training can reduce workplace accidents by ensuring that all employees understand potential risks.
ex.zh: 强制性安全培训能确保所有员工了解潜在风险，从而减少工作场所事故。

tip: 常用于法规或制度要求；反义词为optional。

senses.en: Someone who takes over another person's job or position.
Something that replaces an earlier thing of the same kind.

ex.en: The retiring coach introduced her successor to the team.
ex.zh: 即将退休的教练向队员们介绍了她的接任者。

ex.en: A new leader should give their successor enough guidance to ensure that essential public services continue smoothly.
ex.zh: 新任领导者应为自己的接任者提供充分指导，确保基本公共服务平稳运行。

tip: 用successor to sb；不专指财产继承人。

senses.en: Unable to stop doing something.

ex.en: He is a compulsive hand-washer.
ex.zh: 他有强迫性洗手的习惯。

senses.en: A range of related ideas, qualities, or possibilities
A range of colours or waves arranged by wavelength or frequency

ex.en: Our book club welcomes a wide spectrum of opinions.
ex.zh: 我们的读书会欢迎各种不同的观点。

ex.en: Universities should provide support for students across the entire spectrum of academic abilities and social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 大学应为各种学业水平和社会背景的学生提供支持。

col: a broad spectrum of｜广泛的各种……
across the spectrum｜涵盖整个范围
tip: 复数可用spectra或spectrums。

senses.en: relating to raising animals
showing peaceful country life

ex.en: The painting shows a pastoral scene.
ex.zh: 这幅画描绘了田园风光。

ex.en: Pastoral societies depended on herds of cattle, sheep or goats rather than on growing crops.
ex.zh: 畜牧社会依靠牛羊群生活，而非种植庄稼。

tip: 历史义与艺术义都常考。

senses.en: An official responsible for keeping formal records.
A hospital doctor receiving advanced specialist training in Britain.

ex.en: The registrar checked our documents before the wedding ceremony.
ex.zh: 婚礼仪式开始前，登记员核查了我们的证件。

ex.en: The university registrar oversees student records and ensures that graduation requirements are consistently applied.
ex.zh: 大学注册主任管理学生档案，并确保毕业要求得到一致执行。

tip: 既可指登记官，也可指英国接受专科培训的医生。

senses.en: protection from danger, trouble, or bad weather
a safe place offering protection from danger or difficulty

ex.en: We took refuge under a bridge during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，我们躲到桥下避雨。

ex.en: Urban parks provide a refuge for wildlife as expanding cities gradually replace natural habitats with buildings.
ex.zh: 随着城市扩张，建筑逐渐取代自然栖息地，城市公园为野生动物提供了庇护所。

col: a refuge from｜躲避……的庇护处
tip: take/seek refuge in表示“在……避难”；refuge通常作名词。

senses.en: Too brightly coloured or heavily decorated to look attractive.

ex.en: He wore a gaudy jacket covered in shiny sequins.
ex.zh: 他穿了一件缀满亮片的花哨夹克。

ex.en: Some residents argue that gaudy decorations in historic districts undermine the visual character of traditional buildings.
ex.zh: 一些居民认为，历史街区里俗艳的装饰破坏了传统建筑的视觉风貌。

tip: 含贬义，指颜色或装饰过分抢眼，不只是鲜艳。

senses.en: Producing many works, results or achievements.
Producing many young, flowers, fruits or seeds.

ex.en: My aunt is a prolific painter with two studios.
ex.zh: 我姑姑是位多产的画家，拥有两间画室。

ex.en: Prolific researchers can contribute substantially to scientific progress, but publication quantity should not outweigh quality.
ex.zh: 成果丰硕的研究者能大力推动科学进步，但发表数量不应比质量更受重视。

col: a prolific breeder｜繁殖力强的动物
tip: 强调产出多，不等于作品质量一定高。

senses.en: a field of grass, often containing wildflowers

ex.en: We spread our picnic blanket in a sunny meadow.
ex.zh: 我们在阳光明媚的草地上铺开了野餐毯。

ex.en: Protecting wildflower meadows helps maintain biodiversity by providing food and shelter for insects and birds.
ex.zh: 保护野花草地能为昆虫和鸟类提供食物与栖息地，从而有助于维持生物多样性。

tip: meadow多指乡间草地，不是修剪整齐的lawn。

senses.en: Appear as a large, often threatening or unclear shape.
Seem likely to happen soon, causing worry.
A machine or frame used to weave cloth.

ex.en: A huge ship loomed out of the morning fog.
ex.zh: 一艘巨轮从晨雾中隐约显现。

ex.en: As water shortages loom, governments must invest in efficient irrigation and encourage households to reduce unnecessary consumption.
ex.zh: 随着缺水危机逼近，政府必须投资高效灌溉，并鼓励家庭减少不必要的用水。

col: loom large｜显得突出而令人担忧
tip: 动词常带压迫或担忧感；loom large指问题突出。

senses.en: Travelling faster than sound, or involving such speeds.

ex.en: We heard a loud boom as the supersonic aircraft passed.
ex.zh: 超音速飞机飞过时，我们听到了一声巨响。

ex.en: Supersonic passenger aircraft could shorten international journeys, but their noise and fuel consumption remain major concerns.
ex.zh: 超音速客机可以缩短国际旅程，但其噪声和燃油消耗仍是主要问题。

tip: 指速度超过声速；“超声波的”通常用ultrasonic。

senses.en: Acting suddenly without thinking carefully.

ex.en: Teenagers can be more impulsive than adults.
ex.zh: 青少年可能比成年人更冲动。

senses.en: a weight that swings back and forth

ex.en: The old clock has a pendulum.
ex.zh: 那座老钟有个钟摆。

ex.en: Galileo noticed that a pendulum takes the same time to swing regardless of how wide the swing is.
ex.zh: 伽利略注意到，无论摆幅大小，单摆摆动一次的时间相同。

col: swing of the pendulum｜（舆论等）钟摆效应
tip: 比喻观点的来回摆动。

senses.en: Legal responsibility for something, especially damage or loss.
Money owed by a person or organisation.
Someone or something that creates problems or disadvantages.

ex.en: Our insurance covers liability for damage to neighbouring homes.
ex.zh: 我们的保险承保对邻居住宅造成损坏所需承担的责任。

ex.en: Clear rules on legal liability encourage companies to take greater responsibility for the safety of their products.
ex.zh: 明确的法律责任规定能促使企业更加重视其产品的安全性。

tip: 责任常不可数；债务常用复数liabilities。

senses.en: relating to the study of knowledge, existence, and values
accepting difficulties calmly as a natural part of life

ex.en: Our conversation became philosophical as we discussed life's purpose.
ex.zh: 我们谈到人生的意义时，对话变得富有哲学意味。

ex.en: Debates about artificial intelligence raise philosophical questions concerning responsibility, human identity, and the meaning of creativity.
ex.zh: 关于人工智能的辩论提出了涉及责任、人类身份和创造力含义的哲学问题。

col: philosophical about setbacks｜对挫折持豁达态度
tip: be philosophical about表示对不如意的事想得开。

senses.en: An additional, often unexpected consequence of an action or decision.

ex.en: We hadn't considered every ramification of moving so far away.
ex.zh: 我们没有考虑到搬去那么远的地方会带来的每一种后续影响。

ex.en: Policymakers must consider the long-term ramifications of replacing public transport routes with privately operated services.
ex.zh: 政策制定者必须考虑以私营服务取代公共交通线路所带来的长期影响。

col: have ramifications for｜对……产生后续影响
tip: 通常用复数ramifications，常指复杂或意外后果。

senses.en: a device that increases the strength of sound or electrical signals

ex.en: He connected his guitar to a small amplifier.
ex.zh: 他把吉他接到了一台小型扩音器上。

ex.en: An amplifier can make a speaker's voice clearly audible throughout a large lecture hall.
ex.zh: 扩音器可以让整个大型报告厅都清楚地听到演讲者的声音。

tip: amplifier放大信号；speaker把信号转为声音。

senses.en: to fix something firmly inside a surrounding material
to place digital content within a webpage or document
to make something an established part of a system or culture

ex.en: The artist embedded small shells in the wet clay.
ex.zh: 艺术家把小贝壳嵌入湿黏土中。

ex.en: Schools should embed environmental awareness in everyday lessons rather than discuss sustainability only on special occasions.
ex.zh: 学校应将环保意识融入日常课程，而不是只在特殊场合讨论可持续发展。

tip: 过去式embedded，分词embedding均双写d。

senses.en: A misleading change in how facts or ideas are presented.
An unwanted change in shape, sound, or appearance.

ex.en: His version of our conversation was a complete distortion.
ex.zh: 他对我们谈话的转述完全歪曲了原意。

ex.en: The distortion of scientific findings in news reports can undermine public understanding of health risks.
ex.zh: 新闻报道对科学研究结果的歪曲可能妨碍公众理解健康风险。

col: a distortion of the facts｜对事实的歪曲
tip: distortion of the facts指歪曲事实。

senses.en: living for more than two years
lasting a long time or happening again and again

ex.en: Roses are perennial plants.
ex.zh: 玫瑰是多年生植物。

ex.en: Perennial grasses keep their roots alive through winter, which helps hold prairie soil in place.
ex.zh: 多年生草类的根整个冬天都活着，有助于固定草原土壤。

tip: 对比 annual（一年生的）。

senses.en: To strike forcefully, especially with a whip or like one.
To fasten things tightly together using rope or cord.
An eyelash, or a stroke delivered with a whip.

ex.en: Heavy rain lashed the windows throughout the night.
ex.zh: 大雨整夜猛烈地拍打着窗户。

ex.en: As storms lash coastal communities, stronger sea defences become increasingly important for protecting homes and essential infrastructure.
ex.zh: 随着风暴猛烈袭击沿海社区，更坚固的海防设施对保护住房和重要基础设施愈发重要。

col: lash against the windows｜猛烈拍打窗户
lash out at｜猛烈抨击；攻击
tip: lash out at可指突然攻击或猛烈抨击。

senses.en: A substance with no medical effect given as if it were a real drug.

ex.en: Some patients improved after taking only a placebo.
ex.zh: 有些病人只吃了安慰剂就好转了。

senses.en: A reduction in the amount of something available

ex.en: The garden's poor growth suggested depletion of soil nutrients.
ex.zh: 花园里的植物长势不佳，说明土壤养分可能已大量流失。

ex.en: Rapid depletion of groundwater threatens agricultural production in regions where rainfall is increasingly unpredictable.
ex.zh: 在降雨越来越难以预测的地区，地下水的快速消耗威胁着农业生产。

tip: 常接of，表示资源或储备减少，不一定已耗尽。

senses.en: successful or showing great happiness after winning

ex.en: The triumphant captain lifted the trophy above her head.
ex.zh: 获胜的队长把奖杯举过头顶。

ex.en: After years of campaigning, residents were triumphant when the council agreed to protect their local woodland.
ex.zh: 经过多年的争取，地方议会同意保护当地林地，居民们为此欢欣鼓舞。

tip: 既可指取得胜利，也可形容获胜后的得意神情。

senses.en: Able to recover quickly after difficulties or damage
Able to return to its original shape after being bent

ex.en: These resilient plants recovered quickly after the summer drought.
ex.zh: 这些生命力顽强的植物在夏季干旱后很快恢复了生机。

ex.en: Investing in local support networks can help communities become more resilient to economic and environmental shocks.
ex.zh: 投资地方支持网络可以帮助社区更好地应对经济和环境冲击。

col: resilient to shocks｜能抵御冲击的
tip: 既可形容人或经济的韧性，也可指材料回弹。

senses.en: To use something incorrectly or for a harmful purpose.
The incorrect or harmful use of something.

ex.en: You could damage that knife if you misuse it.
ex.zh: 如果使用不当，你可能会弄坏那把刀。

ex.en: Organisations that misuse personal data risk losing public trust and may face substantial legal penalties.
ex.zh: 滥用个人数据的机构可能失去公众信任，并面临严厉的法律处罚。

col: misuse personal data｜滥用个人数据
misuse of resources｜资源的不当使用
tip: 动词词尾读/ z /，名词词尾读/ s /。
